title: Grid Layout with SVG
author: Jesse Piña, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: 4D SVG-based Grid Layout component (GL_ command set)
Array-driven grid templates for text and image display
Picture-object-based grid rendering with context menus

historical_commentary.text: The grid-layout-as-alternative-to-rows concept remains a valid UI pattern, but this note's implementation is entirely built on the now-legacy 4D SVG component and its GL_ custom component API, rendering output into a picture object rather than any modern layout mechanism. Building a grid layout in 4D today would be done far more simply using a list box in grid/tile mode, CSS-based layout in a web area, or 4D View Pro, making the specific component and technique here obsolete despite the underlying UX idea staying sound.
related_updates: List boxes with grid/collection display modes, and CSS Grid/Flexbox inside a web area, are now the standard ways to build grid-style layouts in 4D applications
4D View Pro (introduced v17+) for spreadsheet/grid-style data presentation
